name: Gabor Phase-Shift Guillotine
description: The lethal saw engineered to execute spatial betrayals (Phase Shifts). If [Gabor Energy] interrogates the brute intensity of surface ridges, [Gabor Phase] stabs deeply into the mathematical continuity of the wave itself. The interfering pixel wave-fronts sliding across authentic organic surfaces inherently drift at synchronous, unbroken natural angles. However, when forcing two alien objects stitched from a Photoshop void together, the Gabor phase-chain violently shatters—suddenly snapping angles, disintegrating, and losing phase like severely misaligned mechanical gear teeth.
algorithm: 2D Gabor Extremity De-Phasing & Congruency Fracture (Shift Var)
mechanism: It drops an acoustic needle directly onto the angular heartbeat of the optical illusion. The Fourier matrix interwoven with the Gabor core outputs twin data streams: True Value (visual mass) and Imaginary Value (Angular Phase). Human biology is entirely blind to this metric, natively hard-wired to process luminosity, not Phase angles. This executioner algorithm exclusively targets that Phase. Directly at the spliced fold between a synthesized torso and the victim's authentic neckline... the system detects a devastating Phase shift exceeding 180 degrees. The sirens wail! Irrefutable proof of a non-native, biologically impossible splice.
parameters: Morphology: 2D Complex Gabor Node, Analytics: Imaginary Numerator Phase Stripping, Tribunal: Unsynchronized Phase Slip Margin
accuracy: Hyper-Elite (81-90%) - The ultimate 'Third Eye' scrutinizing the jagged, microscopic disaster-zones left behind by clumsy Magic Wand / Lasso tool selection borders.
source: Mathematical Phase Convolution Digital Signal Forensics Archives
useCase: Rains absolute hellfire down upon the god-like defective splices created via Deep Inpainting and Copy-Move facial tracking surgeries—zones where the lighting/shadow manipulation appears flawless, but the Phase Waves violently crashing from two disparate source-images spectacularly collapse into chaotic static.

references.title: Kovesi, P. (1999). Image features from phase congruency. Videre: Journal of computer vision research.

strengths:
• Trying to hide the crime scene using cheap Lighting (Contrast/Level/Curve) adjustments is utterly impotent against Phase Shift hunting. Gabor Phase is terrifyingly immune and stubborn to arbitrary pixel intensity manipulation. Forgery is instantly exposed.
• Decisively dissects the dark, sensitive matrix angularity, completely ripping the mask off of malicious Adobe 'Smudge/Blur' tools because artists inherently mangle the Phase angles while desperately attempting to hide the seam.
limitations:
• The precision blade violently deflects and shatters when submerged in aggressively dark, chaotic luminous noise conditions, deeply burying the fragile Gabor Phase wave beneath an impenetrable, bleeding layer of raw grain.
• It is continuously traumatized and blinded by extreme lossy compression, which brutally slaughters the real-imaginary matrix architecture of the pixel grid, tangling the phase into an unreadable, chaotic rat's nest.
